About

My work sits at the boundary of statistical rigor and modern machine learning, focused on healthcare AI, computer vision, and low-resource NLP, and on deploying these methods as real-world, full-stack systems. I enjoy doing research, competitions, hackathons, and applied projects. I love exchanging perspectives. Feel free to reach out.

On Research

I think research is beautiful. I love when I see the patterns in datasets and explore them. Research, to me, is not confined to one domain. People ask me what my goal is, or whether I want a PhD. Honestly, I have no idea. I do research because I love it.

Goals

Philosophy, Psychology, Neuroscience & AI

I am deeply interested in the intersection of mind and machine — how insights from philosophy of mind, cognitive psychology, and neuroscience can inform how we build and think about artificial intelligence, and what AI in turn reveals about cognition itself.

Machine Learning in Healthcare & Physical Science

In healthcare, ML can reach patients that specialist care cannot — predicting disease, flagging risk, making the invisible visible in clinical data. In physical science, the laws are known but the patterns are not, and models that respect domain constraints while discovering what lies beyond human intuition are some of the most interesting things you can build.

Faculty Finder

I am working on a platform for PhD aspirants to find professors whose research aligns with their interests.

Agentic AI & LLMs

Building and studying autonomous LLM-based systems that can plan, use tools, and act across multi-step tasks, with a genuine interest in where these systems work, where they fail, and why.
